name: Floral Queen
description:
The Vibe: Refined, comforting, and majestically sophisticated.

The Scent Journey: Launches with an uplifting, bright burst of citrus and juicy fruits. The fragrance then transitions into a beautiful, soft heart of elegant florals and romantic roses wrapped in subtle sweetness. Finally, it settles into a luxurious, long-lasting trail of warm patchouli, smooth woods, soft musk, and powdery accents.

Best For: Those who want a signature floral scent with a deep, sophisticated dry-down.
